import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        raise RuntimeError()
    s = line.strip()
    ans = 0
    even = False
    prev = ''
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        if i == 0 or c != prev:
            if i > 0 and even:
                ans += 1
            even = False
            prev = c
        else:
            even = not even
    if even:
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
